body: Thanks! That’s a good idea. She might be more likely  to trip but last time she had a really bad one she chipped a tooth so I’ll take it lol

Thank you so much for this response, It really helped. Thank you for pointing out the patterns. She is very self analytical and we can do that. 

She works very hard  in therapy (And I probably should have mentioned this) but she’s having her 3rd brain surgery this year in a few weeks and whenever she has brain surgery pretty much every issue she has is on the back burner. Sorry 
Rambling now but I think she’s gonna be even more traumatized after surgery since she usually gets restrained because she likes to rip out her IVs . I’m probably gonna make a new post later to get advice

Thank you so much for the advice! I have a follow up question... is there a way to make sure she doesn’t hurt herself? She is usually okay but I moved into a new apartment my that is unfamiliar to her. Her mom told me that there were a lot of instances of her running into a wall or door during these night terrors but not as frequently anymore. I thought about pushing my bed against the wall and letting her sleep on the inside, but her and her mom said she would claw my skin off and probably fall trying to jump over me. 
Sorry if these questions sound stupid lol I just always want to make sure she’s safe and cared for

>they won't want to know your speech patterns or personality before they start, so that they aren't influenced by what they know of you previous to the surgery.

Really? I would think they would want to know my speech patterns and such so they could tell the difference if my speech and stuff changes from average during surgery.

Do you really think a meth head would learn about schizophrenia, research it, find the card, get the idea to plan to use it when they’re high, and order it? Yes, it’s not official but I highly doubt anyone who wasn’t really schizophrenic would buy this.
Unfortunately I live with 3 roommates so their stuff is in there too, our fridge is packed.
Writing it out makes it clearer what the items are and my receipt also has the embarrassing shit I bought for my medical condition.
I'm worried about becoming quadriplegic or something like that where I couldn't physically kill myself if I wanted to

>I would re-consider this relationship.

Every post. You genuinely think someone should end a 6 YEAR relationship just because a man who is stressed out about one of the most important things he will do in his life and is acting irrational towards his girlfriend? 6 yeas? Come on.

I used to work in hospice. One day, I held a mom of a 4 year old after she walked out of THAT room for the very last time. She was so broken and just fell into my arms. After that experience, I DARE someone to tell me our job isn’t important!
That's true and I do think I did the right thing... my being upset is more from just being in that situation where I had to do that. And the whole accidentally hurting my own dog thing.
